holderPosition.says: The official site says each TER represents 0.01 g of 99.99% gold held in the holder's name, which reads as an ownership interest in pooled gold; the contractual right and the obligor are unverified. verdict.summary: The issuer's own side can be said: T from the site, an inventory split into allocated and unallocated gold, and the Royal Audit Authority's inspection, which it publishes. But the operative terms are unreadable, so no claim kind can be chosen with confidence, and the mint is Token-2022 with a permanent delegate the reader cannot show. No vault, account provider or examiner of reserves against supply is named, so every holds and the audited certification have no signer.
